name: Steakhouse USDT V2

collateral: USDT deposited into a Steakhouse-curated Morpho vault that allocates across Morpho lending markets backed by blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626-style Morpho vault shares appreciate against USDT as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem vault shares for available USDT liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return
